summary: ICON plc filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, announcing the scheduling of its first quarter 2026 earnings release for June 23, 2026, after market close, with a conference call on June 24, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings schedule announcement by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16. It contains no special situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or capital returns. The forward-looking statements are standard cautionary language. This is an ordinary notification of an earnings event, not a special-situation filing.
